title: Range of resistance
description: Essential: The final answer must state the correct range for the rheostat resistance, e.g., 0.4 Ω ≤ R ≤ 10 Ω.

title: Maximum rheostat power
description: Essential: The final answer must state the correct maximum power of the rheostat, i.e., 18 W.

title: Force balance setup
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law for equilibrium along the incline, equating the component of gravity, friction, and magnetic force.

title: Magnetic force expression
description: Important: The solution must correctly express the magnetic force on the rod as F = BIL, relating it to the circuit current.

title: Circuit current analysis
description: Important: The solution must use Ohm's law for the complete circuit to express the current as I = E/(R + r).

title: Friction direction consideration
description: Important: The solution must correctly determine the direction of friction (up or down the incline) for both limiting cases to find the resistance range.

title: Power derivation
description: Optional: The solution may show the derivation of the rheostat power as P = I²R or P = E²R/(R+r)².

title: Maximum power condition
description: Optional: The solution may apply the maximum power transfer theorem (R = r) or use calculus to find the maximum.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the force balance uses incorrect signs for friction or magnetic force, leading to wrong resistance limits.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Penalize if mass is not converted to kg or if units are inconsistent in calculations, affecting numerical results.
